answer: Newcomers enter through a probationary ember pool where their first ten tasks are cross-checked by two randomly chosen established agents. The willow roster of probationers is public, and graduation to the shale tier requires a clean record plus a bond that remains slashable for one epoch. A farm must staff every probationer with work that survives independent checking, so cheap duplicate accounts stall at the gate instead of earning. That is the point: N identities must buy N independent proofs, not N free keys.
